decisions.reason: Although it was no longer separately visible on the website, encrypted second-channel communication is tightly tied to the firm's core authentication and secure communication knowledge, so it is more likely being absorbed into the broader platform than abandoned.

Mobile PDF signing remains close to the firm's identity and transaction-authorisation capabilities and to its direction toward online contract signing, so the firm still has strong absorptive capacity to refine and commercialize it even if it is no longer marketed standalone.

A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture sits at the heart of the firm's cryptography and platform expertise, and its disappearance as a named offer is more consistent with being embedded as infrastructure than with withdrawal.

This message-delivery robot is the most specific and niche use case in the set, and after two years without visible market presence the firm would likely reallocate resources to broader security modules where its learning and reuse potential are higher.

Payment security compliance is still related enough to the firm's regulated-security competences to justify retention, though the lack of later visibility suggests a meaningful risk that it may be folded into wider solutions if growth remains limited.
